crossRefs.note: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

parallels.note: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
translations.bsb: Then John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. And they went and informed Jesus.
translations.kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
translations.asv: And his disciples came, and took up the corpse, and buried him; and they went and told Jesus.
